atoms.name: div

atoms.name: mod
atoms.rule: a % b is the remainder a - b * (a / b), with the sign of a (-7 % 2 = -1); b = 0 gives NaN.

atoms.name: neg

atoms.name: reverse
atoms.rule: a @ reverses the decimal digits of |a| and keeps the sign of a (120 @ = 21, -123 @ = -321).

atoms.name: triangle
atoms.rule: # a is sign(a) * |a| * (|a| + 1) / 2, computed exactly; only its result is checked against the bound (# 4 = 10, # -4 = -10).

atoms.name: popcount
atoms.rule: a $ is the number of 1 bits in the binary form of |a| (7 $ = 3).

atoms.name: digitsum
atoms.rule: & a is sign(a) times the sum of the decimal digits of |a| (& -123 = -6).

operators.name: ◇₉₇
operators.definition: a ◇₉₇ b = { (▲₆₈ b) ◇₉₅ b, if a >= 16 and b >= 3 and b < 4; a, if a >= 16 and b >= 79; (♧₃₄ b) % (a ☆₃₆), else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 16 and b ≥ 3 and b < 4, apply ▲₆₈ to b, then apply ◇₉₅ to the result and b; otherwise if a ≥ 16 and b ≥ 79, return a; otherwise apply ♧₃₄ to b, then take the remainder when dividing it by a ☆₃₆.

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ♢₉₈
operators.definition: ♢₉₈ a = { (a ○₃₈) ▲₈₃ (♠₁₆ a), if a < 64; (♦₈₇ a) ♦₇₅ (a △₈₀), else }
operators.plain: If a < 64, apply ○₃₈ to a, then apply ▲₈₃ to the result and (♠₁₆ a); otherwise apply ♦₈₇ to a, then apply ♦₇₅ to the result and (a △₈₀).

operators.name: ♧₉₉
operators.definition: ♧₉₉ a = { a - 6, if a >= 8 and a < 59; a ♢₄ a, if a >= 59 and a < 94; a ♣₆₉ a, else }
operators.plain: If 8 ≤ a < 59, subtract 6 from a; otherwise if 59 ≤ a < 94, compute a ♢₄ a; otherwise compute a ♣₆₉ a.

operators.name: ♤₁₀₀
operators.definition: a ♤₁₀₀ = { a * a, if a < 3; 2 ◇₉₇ a, if a >= 92; a ◇₃₁ 45, else }
operators.plain: If a < 3, multiply a by a; otherwise if a ≥ 92, compute 2 ◇₉₇ a; otherwise compute a ◇₃₁ 45.
